resources.string: Jun ko poori screen pe aapki touch track karne deta hai taaki Jun ki aankhein follow kar sakein
Pupils follow your touch anywhere on screen
Lets Jun read what\'s on your screen and tap/type on your behalf to complete tasks you ask for — like opening apps, reading messages, or changing settings. Jun never reads passwords, PINs, or OTPs.
Needed for Jun\'s Agent mode to see and control the screen
